
---

**First time opening Roomtone?** It isn't signed yet, so macOS and Windows warn you once. On a Mac: open the app, click *Done*, then **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**. On Windows: **More info › Run anyway**. Step by step, with the permission questions and how to check your download: [Opening Roomtone for the first time](https://github.com/ChrispyGee/Roomtone/blob/main/docs/FIRST_RUN.md). Roomtone for Mac is built for Apple silicon only; every file's checksum is in `SHA256SUMS`.
